CubeSat with many hosted payloads.
Description

BRNOsat, set to launch in the second half of 2026, will be built by Spacemanic with Brno University of Technology and Masaryk University Brno.

The launch of the newly planned satellite will be free of charge, but the designers themselves must cover the costs of developing and manufacturing the experiment.
